name: Learning record

title: "[Learning] "
labels: "type:learning-record, curation:review-later"
assignees: ""
---

## Session summary

What was explored, and why did it matter?

## Current understanding

Explain the idea in your own words, including important assumptions.

## Key concepts and insights

Definitions, reasoning patterns, intuition, examples, or robotics relevance worth preserving.

## Misconceptions or fragile points

What was corrected, surprising, or easy to forget?

## Connections and open questions

Related concepts, prerequisites, existing issues, and unresolved questions.

## Source discussion

Optional link to the original ChatGPT discussion. Private links are not required for later curation.

## Curation intent

The labels carry the editorial intent. Keep exactly one curation label:

- `curation:archive-only`
- `curation:review-later`
- `curation:ready`

The curation label does not choose a repository file. Codex will inspect the textbook and decide whether to create, update, merge, split, combine, or defer notes.
